slope_accommodation.notes: Each fence style accommodates a defined degree of slope (stated as inches of drop over feet of run in the per-style spec diagram, not published as a single company-wide figure). Where slope exceeds a style's rated capacity, installer steps the fence using one of three documented options: (1) end posts with holes cut in the blank side, (2) end posts with U-mount rail brackets on the blank side, (3) blank posts with U-mount brackets on both sides. Racking (routed post system following the grade) is the default/baseline method within each style's rated slope tolerance. U-mount bracket installations require shortening rails since they are not inserted into routed post sockets.
